name: Two-layer quasi-geostrophic (QG) model simulations
size_as_stated: 60 simulations for deterministic training and Bayesian inference, with additional 10 for testing; 10 years per simulation (5 years spin-up excluded)
resolution: 256x256 high-resolution ground truth on 1,000 km x 1,000 km domain; coarse-grained to 32x32 mesh; temporal resolution 1 hour (daily sampling for training trajectories)

scales.note: Idealized two-layer QG turbulence in a 1,000 km square domain; high-res 256x256 grid and coarse-grained 32x32 mesh; 10-year runs (5-year spin-up excluded).
